enable_auto_load_local_gdbinit.description: Whether to enable loading of .gdbinit files from the current working directory (security-sensitive).

safe_paths.description: Colon-separated list of safe directories for auto-loading GDB init files.

history_size.description: Maximum number of commands to store in the command history (0 = unlimited).

history_save.description: Whether to save command history to the history file on exit.

history_filename.description: Path to the file where GDB stores command history.

print_pretty.description: Whether to pretty-print C/C++ structures (with indentation).

print_object.description: Whether to print dynamic (runtime) type of C++ objects.

print_demangle.description: Whether to demangle C++ symbol names in output.

backtrace_past_main.description: Whether to include frames before main() in backtraces.

debug_libthread_db.description: Enable verbose logging for libthread_db (thread debugging) operations.

debug_solib.description: Enable verbose logging for shared library (solib) loading.

default.name: bt-all
default.description: Print full backtrace with all threads (requires 'thread apply' support).

aliases.description: List of user-defined GDB command aliases.

vars.description: List of GDB convenience variables to initialize (e.g., $my_flag = 1).
